watchOS 27.2 will launch next month with multiple new Apple Watch features, and tipster pdfu has also discovered a major change coming to the screenshot function.

New screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2 code, inspired by iPhone

Tipster pdfu has recently been sharing multiple details discovered from Apple code. For example, he was among the first to discover the Readiness app in watchOS 27, and yesterday also leaked the Siri AI interface on HomePod.

In a new post today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a redesigned Apple Watch screenshot experience.

Currently, when you take a screenshot on Apple Watch, the screen simply flashes briefly, and the screenshot is then saved to your photo library.

The new screenshot flow mimics the current approach on iPhone and iPad, letting you choose to share or delete the screenshot immediately.

It remains unclear whether Apple plans to add this change in the next beta of watchOS 27.2, or whether more development time is needed. But even if it doesn't make it into watchOS 27.2, Apple Watch users are expected to experience this feature in the near future.

What do you think of the leaked new screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.
